payload.core_mechanism_summary: Counts existing chord intersections, then for each existing chord adds min(free points inside, free points outside) as crossings from new chords, and adds C(new chords, 2) assuming all new chords mutually cross.
payload.rationale: The solution greedily chooses max crossings per existing chord by taking min of inside/outside free points, and relies on an exchange argument to justify that new chords can all intersect each other optimally.
